nodes.name: Test Builds
nodes.summary: Builds oxiguitar-app, oxiguitar-cli, and plugins for Linux (x86_64, ARM64, X11), Windows (x86_64, ARM64), and macOS (universal) on push to develop. Uploads 14-day artifacts including binaries and test plugins for manual testing by contributors.

nodes.name: CI
nodes.summary: Main CI workflow with 8 parallel checks: formatting (rustfmt), lint (clippy on MSRV and stable, including X11 and individual format readers), multi-platform tests (Linux x86_64/ARM64, Windows x86_64/ARM64, macOS), plugin template verification on all platforms, speed budget tests, license/advisory checks (cargo-deny), no-network isolation test, and DCO sign-off check. A ci-success gate job requires all checks to pass before merging.

nodes.name: Debian
nodes.summary: Weekly and on-change workflow for Debian packaging: audits all Rust crates against Debian sid packages, then builds .deb packages offline in a Docker-based Debian sid container (skipped if sid's rustc is older than the project's MSRV). Runs lintian checks and installs packages into a clean sid for smoke testing.

nodes.name: Manual
nodes.summary: Builds the user manual (docs/manual/) and plugin developer guide (docs/plugins/) as mdBook sites. On PRs, builds and checks for broken links without publishing. On pushes to main, builds and deploys the manual to GitHub Pages at mateusrdp.github.io/oxiguitar/ and the guide at mateusrdp.github.io/oxiguitar/plugin-guide/.

nodes.name: Fuzz
nodes.summary: Fuzz testing of all file readers (guitar_pro_3_5, guitar_pro_6, guitar_pro_7, gpif), the .gp writer, and plugin dispatch/tabs using cargo-fuzz on nightly Rust. On PRs runs short 4-minute checks; on manual dispatch runs up to 680 minutes split across two jobs sharing corpus. Targets include any_file format detection and plugin_tab on PRs only.

nodes.name: Interop
nodes.summary: Interoperability testing for .gp file output: writes all fixtures as .gp using oxiguitar-formats' write_gp example, then verifies that alphaTab (a JavaScript Guitar Pro reader) and MuseScore 4 read every file beat-by-beat with matching tracks, bars, and notes. Only runs on PRs touching format crates, fixtures, or interop scripts.

nodes.name: Listening Pack
nodes.summary: On-demand workflow that renders all reference songs (fixtures/reference/*.gp) into WAV files using oxiguitar-cli's SoundFont plugin with every supported sound set: FluidR3 GM, MuseScore General, FreePats electric guitar banks (clean, jazz, direct), and multiple SFZ instruments (Karoryfer guitars/basses, SM Drums, Naked Drums, Big Rusty Drums, MuldjordKit). Each set is a separate artifact kept 14 days for manual listening review.

nodes.name: Release Packages
nodes.summary: Full release pipeline producing .deb, .rpm, AppImage (Linux x86_64/ARM64, Wayland and X11), Windows .zip (x86_64/ARM64), and macOS universal .dmg. Generates third-party license report, builds and smoke-tests each package in its target environment (Debian sid, Fedora, native runner), generates SHA256SUMS, and creates a GitHub draft release on v* tag pushes. Core packages exclude plugins; basic plugins ship separately.

nodes.name: Spikes
nodes.summary: Advisory-only workflow (never blocks merges) for building and testing experimental spikes: GUI toolkit spikes (slint, iced, egui) on all platforms using MSRV, audio spikes (NeuralAmpModeler, sound synthesis, timing benchmarks) on all platforms, and on-demand NeuralAmpModeler-rs listening renders with FreePats guitars, amp captures, and cabinet IRs.
